contributing_factors.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
contributing_factors.reasoning: The single frontend replica is constrained to 100m CPU (50m requested), and repeated CPU throttling during the incident reduces its ability to serve requests. The frontend-proxy request-error alert and load-generator connection failures are downstream symptoms: the captured proxy traces route requests to the frontend service. The frontend deployment is therefore the upstream bottleneck; the proxy and load-generator are not listed as separate causes.
contributing_factors.evidence: k8s_objects_raw.tsv snapshots at 2025-12-15 17:38:48 and later show Deployment frontend with 1 desired/1 ready replica and container resources request=50m CPU, limit=100m. CPUThrottlingHigh fires for pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-5vnt2 at 26.13% (17:39), 25.06% (17:40), and again about 25-26% from 18:00-18:06. During this period RequestErrorRate fires for otel-demo/frontend-proxy at 1.1-3.3%; the 17:47 load-generator error report records ConnectionRefusedError for GET / and API requests. The frontend-proxy traces identify upstream_cluster=frontend. The frontend pod remains Ready and its node reports Ready without memory/disk/PID pressure, which points to the container CPU cap rather than a missing replica or node failure.
